revision.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - not a real patient. Written for CPT Studio harness@2 tests.
GI Procedure Report
Date of service: 2026-10-21
Procedure date: 2026-10-22
Procedure: Colonoscopy.
Indication: Average-risk screening.
Technique: Landmarks photographed: appendiceal orifice and ileocecal valve. Bowel preparation was good.
Findings: A 6 mm sessile polyp in the ascending colon was removed with a cold snare and retrieved for
pathology. A 3 mm polyp in the rectum was possibly biopsied with cold forceps.
Impression: Two polyps.
Plan: Await pathology. Repeat colonoscopy in 7 years.
